entries.1dfd58f3290034d9: This business wholesales products requiring temperature control, such as refrigerated and frozen goods, and Kei Teion Foods Co., Ltd. wholesales low-temperature food.
entries.1fd286e305688584: This business wholesales products requiring temperature control, such as refrigerated and frozen goods, and Kei Teion Foods Co., Ltd. wholesales low-temperature food. Under affiliated companies, it is positioned as the food service and low-temperature food wholesale division. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥117,837 million, up from ¥114,300 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.2a4b090a1bde197b: This business wholesales alcoholic beverages and is carried out by Sanyo Bussan Co., Ltd. and Yatani Shuhan Co., Ltd. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥254,659 million, up from ¥245,170 million in the previous fiscal year. The reason was an increase in transactions with existing customers. It is stated that alcoholic beverage consumption continues to shrink due to a decline in the drinking population and a move away from alcohol among younger people, and that the rise of businesses from other industries, such as drugstores, has also brought changes to where consumers buy.
entries.3f71eee723bd8025: This is the Group's core business, wholesaling processed foods such as instant foods (including canned and retort foods), dried goods and grains, beverages, luxury goods and seasonings. The company handles wholesaling of processed foods, while Katō Kashi Holdings Co., Ltd. oversees, manages and runs the back-office operations of Katō Kashi Co., Ltd., a confectionery wholesaler, and Uejima Co., Ltd. Wakayama Sangyo Co., Ltd. and Greenwood Factory Co., Ltd. manufacture and process some of the products sold by the Group. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥741,260 million, up from ¥716,628 million in the previous fiscal year. The reason was an increase in transactions with existing customers, mainly supermarkets and drugstores.
entries.46eaa7d8d48ccf9a: This is a business with overseas bases that wholesales processed foods, mainly corresponding to the ambient distribution business.
entries.61e5922ea6241066: This business wholesales alcoholic beverages and is carried out by Sanyo Bussan Co., Ltd. and Yatani Shuhan Co., Ltd.
entries.796a2a4d9e2a6cbf: This is a business not included in reportable segments, mainly logistics.
entries.8c8e7cabc2dc1231: This is a business with overseas bases that wholesales processed foods, mainly corresponding to the ambient distribution business. It wholesales mainly processed foods in Malaysia, Singapore, Vietnam and China. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥95,746 million, up from ¥89,328 million in the previous fiscal year. The increase was due to the consolidation of Teo Soon Seng Pte.Ltd., whose shares were acquired in October 2023, and the effect of exchange rate fluctuations.
entries.a6c46ca496296eaf: This is a business not included in reportable segments, mainly logistics. Manna Unyu Co., Ltd., Kato Logistics Co., Ltd. and Okinawa Logistics Co., Ltd. undertake part of the logistics operations of the company and its subsidiaries. Kato SC Asia Investment Co., Ltd. oversees, manages and operates some of the overseas affiliated companies, Kato Fudosan Co., Ltd. handles insurance agency operations and others, and Advance Kitchen Co., Ltd. operates franchised food service outlets. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,760 million.
